title: 4th Unique Awards Winners Revealed — 88 Awards Across Domestic & Go-Global Cases
summary: Early spring 2023: 4th Unique Awards (非凡奖) winners announced. Call opened Sep 19, 2022 → 2+ months submissions + 1+ month scoring.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Ranking / awards · January 4, 2023

Early spring 2023: 4th Unique Awards (非凡奖) winners announced. Call opened Sep 19, 2022 → 2+ months submissions + 1+ month scoring.

Scale. Hundreds of cases → 88 awards. Industries: beauty, apparel, auto, FMCG, appliances, food (2C) + enterprise services, B2B, manufacturing, agri (2B). Scenes: marketing, retail, sales, ops, service, experience. First year with dedicated go-global commercial awards — 36.36% of winners are overseas cases.

Jury: 100 experts — listed-co / brand / VC / vendor chairs, CEOs, execs, seniors — online scoring. Unique Awards (since 2019) from Unique Research spotlights digital-commerce leaders and rising forces across MarTech, creative, sales conversion, experience insight. Full domestic + go-global winner lists in CN images.

— END —
